basic_details.job_title: NIPER-Guwahati Research Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Guwahati (NIPER-Guwahati) has released the recruitment notification for Research Manager-Scientific (Contractual) vacancy on a contract basis. Candidates holding an M.Sc./M.Pharma from recognised University/Institute with minimum 10 years experience are eligible to apply. The approved pay for the post is Rs. 1,25,000 per month, with an initial engagement of 11 months under advertisement number NIPERG/Rect./05(C)/2026. age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is not more than 40 years.

qualification.details: Post Name Essential Qualification Experience Required Research Manager-Scientific (Contractual) M.Sc. / M.Pharma from recognised University/Institute Minimum 10 (Ten) years of experience in research/teaching/industry and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas.

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form in the prescribed format completely and ink-sign it.
Gather self-attested copies of all relevant supporting documents, including age proof, all essential degree mark sheets and certificates, proper experience certificates, and resume.

Send the completed application and documents by Speed Post or Courier to reach latest by 30 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM to: The Registrar i/c, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (NIPER) Guwahati, Vill: Sila Katamur (Halugurisuk), P.O.: Changsari, Dist: Kamrup, Assam-India, Pin -781101

Send an advance copy of the application along with self-attested copies of all relevant supporting documents via email to [email protected] with the subject line “Recruitment for the post of Research Manager (Scientific)”.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential qualification, experience, and meet the age criteria specified for the post. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience in handling HPLC/LCMS/GCMS/cell culture, immunological assays, or molecular diagnostics and in vivo models and maintenance of instruments. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and official ISO laboratory accreditations will be an added advantage. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience in Project Management. The maximum age limit is not more than 40 years.

rows.experience_required: Minimum 10 (Ten) years of experience in research/teaching/industry and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,25,000/- per month. Allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, LTC Bonus, Medical Allowance, CCA, and any retirement or terminal benefits are not applicable. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinized, and short-listing will be carried out based on relevant work experience and knowledge of the relevant domains. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview, which may be conducted as a walk-in or online interview by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for an initial duration of 11 months, which may be extended based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not more than 40 years.

faq.question: Q3. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through Speed Post or Courier to the Registrar i/c, NIPER Guwahati, and an advance copy must be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on relevant work experience and domain knowledge, followed by an online or physical interview conducted by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q5. Are allowances provided in addition to the monthly salary?
faq.answer: No, allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, LTC Bonus, Medical Allowance, and CCA are not applicable.
